meta.assembly:
运行时默认 = resolvePrompt(inline ?? file ?? fallback) ；fallback = 内置常量[+council强化段] + '

' + TASK_REJECTION_INSTRUCTION。本目录 .md = 内置常量（展开共享规则）[+council强化段] + '

' + 拒绝指令，与默认行为逐字节等价。
meta.TASK_REJECTION_INSTRUCTION: If a task is outside your role, do not attempt partial work. Return a brief reason to the orchestrator.
meta.council_reinforcement_note: council.md 已内联 COUNCIL_SYNTHESIS_REINFORCEMENT 与拒绝指令（代码会追加到 fallback，但不追加到 file prompt）
meta.resolvePrompt_priority: inline(oh-my-opencode-slim.json agents.<name>.prompt) ?? file(<name>.md) ?? fallback；随后追加 <name>_append.md

explorer.description: Fast codebase search and pattern matching. Use for finding files, locating code patterns, and answering 'where is X?' questions.

librarian.description: External documentation and library research. Use for official docs lookup, GitHub examples, and understanding library internals.

oracle.description: Strategic technical advisor. Use for architecture decisions, complex debugging, code review, simplification, and engineering guidance.

designer.description: UI/UX design, review, and implementation. Use for styling, responsive design, component architecture and visual polish.

fixer.description: Fast implementation specialist. Receives complete context and task spec, executes code changes efficiently.

observer.description: Visual analysis. Use for interpreting images, screenshots, PDFs, and diagrams - extracts structured observations without loading raw files into main context. Requires a vision-capable model.

council.description: Multi-model consensus agent that synthesizes viewpoints from council members to make informed decisions with higher confidence than single models

councillor.description: Read-only council advisor. Examines codebase and provides independent analysis. Spawned internally by the council system.
